messages:
lauren: Heads-up — opened a docs PR to update streaming + retry + pagination snippets across Python/TS/Go. Need quick sanity check on the cross-lang examples and the cursor/resume semantics. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4782

mike: Saw it, linking now. Quick note: the pagination example currently uses 'resume_token' but our SDK landed on 'cursor' last month, so we'll want consistent naming.

anya: I can take the Python and Go examples. Can you paste the minimal code you want included? Prefer <=12 lines per language.

lauren: Pasting the compact examples I prototyped below. These are intentionally minimal so they render well in the docs and are runnable in CI.

lauren: ```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client()

# stream with retry/backoff + cursor-based pagination
for chunk in client.stream("gpt-medium", prompt="Tell me a joke", max_tokens=64, cursor=None, retry_policy={"backoff": "exponential"}):
    print(chunk.text)
```

lauren: ```ts
import { Redwood } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = new Redwood()

// async iterator over streamed tokens, with retry hook
for await (const ch of client.stream('gpt-medium', { prompt: 'Tell me a joke', maxTokens: 64, cursor: undefined })) {
  console.log(ch.text)
}
```

lauren: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient()
// simple streaming loop with cursor param
iter := client.Stream(context.Background(), "gpt-medium", redwood.StreamOpts{Prompt: "Tell me a joke", MaxTokens: 64, Cursor: ""})
for iter.Next() {
    fmt.Println(iter.Current().Text)
}
```

sam: Small nit: in the TS example use `cursor: null` vs `undefined`? Our docs usually show `null` for explicit "no cursor" to avoid confusion. Also mention `client.cancel()` or passing an AbortSignal for cancellation.

mike: I pushed a tiny rename in the PR to use `cursor` everywhere and added a sentence about migration from `resume_token` -> `cursor`.

docs-bot: link-checker: failed to resolve package path in Go example: "github.com/redwood/old-sdk" referenced in a comment. Suggest replacing with canonical import `github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-go` before merge.

jia: I'll update the PR to fix the import and add a short migration note under "SDK changes". Also will add a link to the migration guide: https://docs.redwood.com/migration/sdk-cursors

anya: LGTM on the code examples after the import fix. Left two tiny comments in the PR (whitespace + wording). Please add a smoke test that runs these examples in the docs CI so we don't regress.

lauren: Plan: merge after CI green, docs-bot link fix, and jia's migration note. Can someone add the smoke test (runs examples/streaming_smoke_test.py and ts/go counterparts)?

sam: I'll add a GH action job called `examples-smoke-test` that runs the three small scripts. ETA today.

mike: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. I'll watch the PR for final CI and do the merge once green.

lauren: Thanks all! :sparkles: If anything else comes up I'll follow up in-thread.
